title: Scope Codex saved approval defaults to ordinary session creation
outcome: The shared app-server feature doc sets correct expectations for ordinary, delegated, template-created and discovered sessions.
acceptance: The feature doc limits the saved-default statement to the creation paths that use it and accounts for the overrides in create requests, delegation, orchestrator templates and startup discovery.
The change describes existing behavior without changing approval policy, and uses the applicable authority-text review procedure.
